sections.heading: Medal, Coin & Collector Presentation Box FAQ
sections.text: Questions Medal, Coin & Collector Presentation Box FAQ How is the insert cut to fit my medal or coin? From your drawing or a physical sample. The cavity follows the item's outline and depth so it sits flat and does not move; a finger notch lets the owner lift it out. Can the box hold a certificate as well? Yes. A certificate card can sit in a recess inside the lid or under the insert. EVA foam or velvet insert? EVA foam gives a crisp, protective cut-out and suits heavier metal pieces. A velvet-covered insert looks more like a jewelry box and suits display gifts. Both are quoted from the same size. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Do you make the medals or coins? No. We make the box and the insert; the medal, coin or badge comes from your own supplier.

main_text: Home › Products › Medal, Coin & Collector Presentation Box Custom Packaging Factory · Shenzhen, China Custom Medal & Coin Presentation Box Images are concept renders for illustration, not photographs of produced samples. Your box is developed to your specification and approved on a physical sample before bulk production. A presentation box gives a medal, coin, badge or limited-edition piece a fixed place: a cavity cut to its exact outline in EVA foam or a velvet-covered insert, under a lid that opens like a jewelry box. Event organisers, clubs, mints and collectible brands order them for awards, commemorative editions and numbered series.
